query/name: Workloads: CPU and memory against requests and limits, restarts, pod phases
query/params: {"query":"(sum by (workload, signal) ((label_replace({{cpu_promql}}, \"signal\", \"cpu\", \"\", \"\") or label_replace({{cpu_requests_promql}}, \"signal\", \"cpu_requests\", \"\", \"\") or label_replace({{cpu_limits_promql}}, \"signal\", \"cpu_limits\", \"\", \"\") or label_replace({{memory_promql}}, \"signal\", \"memory\", \"\", \"\") or label_replace({{memory_requests_promql}}, \"signal\", \"memory_requests\", \"\", \"\") or label_replace({{memory_limits_promql}}, \"signal\", \"memory_limits\", \"\", \"\") or label_replace({{restarts_promql}}, \"signal\", \"restarts_total\", \"\", \"\")) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (workload) {{workload_owner}}) or max by (workload, pod, signal) ((label_replace({{memory_promql}}, \"signal\", \"pod_memory\", \"\", \"\") or label_replace({{memory_limits_promql}}, \"signal\", \"pod_memory_limits\", \"\", \"\")) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (workload) {{workload_owner}}) or label_replace({{phase_promql}}, \"signal\", \"pods\", \"\", \"\"))[{{window}}:{{step}}]"}
